facts.site: Marrindal Concentrator and Hydrocarbon Transfer Facility
facts.title: loss of containment at CV-3100 during transfer operations

response.consequence: The recorded outcome was first aid or minor property damage.

defences.finding: Control LOAD_SUPPORT_FOR_MAINTENANCE: the mechanical support of a load during maintenance access was in place but did not perform, and the root cause analysis classified this as an absent or failed defence.
Control PARK_UP_AND_RESTRAINT: the parking, chocking and restraint of equipment had been bypassed, and the root cause analysis classified this as an absent or failed defence.

Control STORED_ENERGY_DISSIPATION: the dissipation or restraint of trapped and residual energy was never verified as effective, and the root cause analysis classified this as a task or environmental condition.

recommendations: Restore the mechanical support of a load during maintenance access on CV-3100 and M-3100 and record the field verification before this task is next authorised.
Restore the parking, chocking and restraint of equipment on CV-3100 and M-3100 and record the field verification before this task is next authorised.
response.sequence: Work was under way in restoring plant to service, specifically handing back a partially completed isolation. CV-3100 (plant conveyors) is in service for coarse ore and reclaim conveying. The task proceeded during transfer operations while the mechanical support of a load during maintenance access was in place but did not perform. The kinetic energy involved is held as rotating equipment, and the recorded presentation was entanglement, impact, crush.
response.summary: On 19 November 2011 an incident occurred on CV-3100 and M-3100 at Marrindal Concentrator and Hydrocarbon Transfer Facility during transfer operations, releasing kinetic energy held as rotating equipment.
